name: dm-work-surface-plan-stickiness
description: Work-surface: plan a small UI change then stick to it without reviving a rejected approach.

steps.content: We need a dark-mode control. Plan it first: prefer a single toggle in Appearance, not a three-way segmented control.
Good. Sketch that plan in the reply as a concrete component named AppearanceToggle — describe the single toggle only, no files and no repo edits.
Correction: keep AppearanceToggle and the single toggle. Do not switch back to a segmented control.
Continue from that and summarize the final approach after the correction. Keep the component name AppearanceToggle and the single toggle in Appearance.

cases.stale_match: (?i)(switch(?:ing)? back to|revert(?:ing)? to|use a three-way|using a three-way) segmented
